AGENDA
  GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION - REGULAR MEETING
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire
devices using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu. Meetings
are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. Call (818)
548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City
Clerk's Office. For public comments and questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public
comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that agenda item is discussed. If you have
any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the Library,
Arts and Culture Department, at (818) 548-2030, during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents
related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E.
Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  JANUARY 12, 2023 AT 10:00 AM

  1.  REGULAR BUSINESS AGENDA – 10:00 AM
  Roll Call
  a. Report of Recorder, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the January 12, 2023
  Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission was Posted on
  January 5, 2023 on the Bulletin Board Outside City Hall.

  2.  CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
   Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
  request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the October 20, 2022 Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting

  b. Minutes of the December 8, 2022 Special Arts and Culture Commission Meeting

3.  INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Mariah Ledesma, Public Arts Intern
  b. Samantha Solemnidad, Coro Southern California – Public Affairs Fellow

  c. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Jennifer Fukutomi-Jones, Principal

  Arts & Culture Administrator

4.  WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS

5.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.

 6.  ACTION ITEMS
  a. Selection of a Chairperson to serve a one-year term, beginning January 2023

  b. Selection of a Vice-Chairperson to serve a one-year term, beginning January 2023

  c. Selection and Appointment of Commission Members to Artist Review and
  Selection Committees
  Motion approving two Commission Members to serve a one-year term on the Artist

  2. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS- No Update
  3. PERFORMING ARTS
  i. 2023 Performance Series Application – Update
   4. ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No Update

9.  ADJOURNMENT
  The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday,
  February 9, 2023, at 10:00 AM in City Council Chambers (2nd Floor), 613 E. Broadway.
minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, January 12, 2023, at 10:00 a.m.
1.  ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on January 12, 2023, at 10:02 a.m.
  •  Present: Commissioner Tufenkian, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  •  Absent: Commissioner Vidor, Zadorian
  •  The Agenda for the January 12, 2023, Regular Meeting was posted on January 5, 2023, on the
  Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (INCLUDING MINUTES)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the Commission or the
  audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the October 20, 2022, Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting

  Moved:  Commissioner Tufenkian
  Seconded :  Commissioner Viar

  Ayes:  Commissioners Tufenkian, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Vidor, Zadorian
  Abstain:  None

  b. Minutes of the December 8, 2022, Special Arts and Culture Commission Meeting As Amended

  Moved:  Commissioner Tufenkian
  Seconded :  Commissioner Viar

  Ayes:  Commissioners Tufenkian, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Vidor, Zadorian
  Abstain:  None

3. INTRODUCTIONS & PRESENTATIONS
  1. Mariah Ledesma, Public Arts Intern
  • Ms. Fukutomi_Jones introduced Mariah Ledesma to the Commission, Ms. Ledesma
  expressed he gratitude for the program and thanked the Commission for the opportunity.
  2. Sam Solemnidad, Coro Southern California – Public Affairs Fellow
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones introduced Sam Soemnidad to the Commission, Ms. Solemnidad
  stated she was happy to have an opportunity to work with the Commission and help
  Glendale be the art destination it should be.
  3. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Jennifer Fukutomi-Jones, Principal Arts
  & Culture Administrator
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale
  Library, Arts & Culture locations.

  1
 4. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS - NONE

5. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes. Members of
  the Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the Speaker, but there will be no Debate or
  Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.
  - No Speakers

6. ACTION ITEM(s)
  a. Selection of a Chairperson to serve a one-year term, beginning January 2023
  •  Nomination for Commissioner Viar to serve a one-year term, beginning January 2023.

  Ayes:  Commissioners Tufenkian, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Vidor, Zadorian
  Abstain:  None

  b. Selection of a Vice-Chairperson to serve a one-year term, beginning January 2023
  •  Nomination for Commissioner Tufenkian to serve a one-year term, beginning January
  2023.

  Ayes:  Commissioners Tufenkian, Chairperson Viar, Commissioner Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Vidor, Zadorian
  Abstain:  None

  c. Selection and Appointment of Commission Members to Artist Review and Selection Committees
  1. Motion appointing two Commission Members to serve a one-year term on the Artist Review and
  Selection Committee for the Adams Square Mini Park Gas Station & Storefront Art Program, Beyond
  the Box – Utility Box Mural Art Program and Brand Summer Music Series & 222 East Concert
  Series.

  That regarding the Report to the Commission, dated January 12, 2023, about selecting and
  appointing Commission Members to the Artist Review and Selection Committees, the Commission
  hereby appoints two Commissioners to serve on the Artist Review and Selection Committee, for a
  one-year term, for each of the following Arts and Culture Commission programs and projects:

  Adams Square Mini Park Gas Station & Storefront Art Program –
  Vice Chair Tufenkian, Commissioner Zadorian
  Beyond the Box - Utility Box Mural Art Program –
  Commissioner Yank, Commissioner Vidor
  Brand Summer Music Series & 222 East Concert Series –
  Chairperson Viar, Commissioner Zadorian

  Moved:  Commissioner Yank
  Seconded :  Chairperson Viar

  Ayes:  Commissioners Yank, Vice Chair Tufenkian, Chairperson Viar
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Vidor, Zadorian
  Abstain:  None

  2
   d. Claremont Graduate University – Work Study Program
  1. Motion approving the funding of a financial stipend for a Graduate student from the Claremont
  University - Work Study Program from January to December 2023 to assist with programmatic
  initiatives of the Arts and Culture Commission, in an amount not to exceed $7,000 from the 2022-
  2023 Work Plan.

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves the funding of a financial stipend for a
  Graduate student from the Claremont Graduate University – Arts Administration Work Study
  Program from January to December 2023 to assist with programmatic initiatives of the Arts and
  Culture Commission, in an amount not to exceed $7,000 from the 2022- 2023 Month Work Plan,
  as more fully outlined in the January 12, 2023, Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts
  & Culture Administrator.

  Moved:  Commissioner Yank
  Seconded :  Vice Chair Tufenkian

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Tufenkian, Chairperson Viar, Commissioner Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Vidor, Zadorian
  Abstain:  None

7. DISCUSSION ITEM(s) / REPORT(s)
  a. 2022-2023 Work Plan Progress Updates
  1. CITY-WIDE ARTS
  i. Mural Ordinance – Update
  • Staff is working with Ms. Odenkirk on a final draft of Mural Ordinance and Policies and
  Procedures, hopefully hosting a community meeting and scheduling an initial review by the
  Commission at an upcoming Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission.

  ii. Creative Crosswalks – Update
  • Staff will be working in conjunction with the Public Works department and the artists to
  tentatively install the crosswalk murals some time in February/March 2023. A meeting is
  scheduled for next Tuesday for an update.

  2. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS- No Update

  3. PERFORMING ARTS
  i.  2023 Performance Series Application – Update
  • Staff opened the 2023 Performance Series application intended for music ensembles to
  perform as part of the 222 East Concert Series and Brand Summer Music Series. The
  application is currently open and closes on January 27, 2023, at 5:00 p.m.

  4. ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No Update

  3
   5. MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS
  i.  PR Firm RFP – Update
  • Staff hosted interviews with applicants for the PR Firm and Staff have invited two PR
  Firms to present their proposals for consideration to the Commission during the Regular
  Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission on February 9, 2023.

8. COMMISSION / STAFF COMMENTS
  •  Commissioner Yank thanked the Commission for the past year for being Chairperson
  and appreciated working closely with Staff on launching our public art initiative. She
  stated she’s thrilled to pass on the gable to Chairperson Viar.
  •  Commissioner Yank stated she had a question regarding the Poet Laurate program. She
  wanted to know who was on the review panel that will be selecting the Poet Laureate to
  ensure that diversity was represented on the panel. Dr. Shaffer stated the Glendale
  Library Arts and Culture Assistant Director Nicole Pasini, is working on that program,
  and Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that she would share the panelists with Commission
  after the meeting.
  •  Vice Chair Tufenkian thanked Commissioner Yank for her work the past year as
  Chairperson on the Commission and she’s looking forward to working under
  Chairperson Viar’s leadership. She also thanked Staff for doing an amazing job.
  •  Chairperson Viar thanked Staff and welcomed the new Interns and wished everyone a
  Happy New Year.
  •  Dr. Shaffer thanked outgoing Chairperson Yank for her service and appreciates both
  Chairperson Viar and Vice Chair Tufenkian for stepping up. Dr. Shaffer wanted to note
  for the record that Commissioner Vidor and Zadorian were not present at this meeting.
  He wished everyone a Happy New Year and thanked everyone for their service and
  stated he appreciated legal counsel as well.
  •  Dr. Shaffer announced that Chairperson Jane Viar is being honored by the Glendale
  Latino Association on Thursday, February 23rd at their Awards Luncheon as “Woman of
  the Year.”
  •  Ms. Fukutomi- Jones wanted to reiterate what everyone else said and thanked
  Commissioner Yank for her leadership this past year and stated she’s very excited to
  work with Chairperson Viar. She also shared the Sydney Brundidge, Clairmont graduate
  university work study student last year has accepted a position with 18th Street Art
  Center as their administrative assistant and congratulated her.

9. ADJOURNMENT – 10:32 am
The next Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission is February 9, 2023, at 10:00 a.m., in City
Council Chambers (2nd Floor), 613 E. Broadway.
